case.title: A star in Sagittarius brightened 2.6 times in September 2015, equally in Gaia and NEOWISE: a microlensing candidate
case.hook: Found blind in Oddsky hunts H-0008/H-0009 (NEOWISE x2.7 on 2015 Sep 15). Gaia DR3 epoch photometry shows x2.6 nine days earlier and twenty days later, equal in G and RP. Gaia's own classifier labels the star MICROLENSING.

claims.text: NEOWISE on 2015 Sep 15: x2.7 in W1 and x2.75 in W2 against the star's median; every other visit quiet.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: Gaia DR3 epoch photometry: G x2.60 at -9 d and x2.57 at +20 d, RP the same (hunts/H-0009/reviews/claude-referee-atlas-2026-10-31.md).
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: The Gaia DR3 classifier labels the star MICROLENSING (score 0.26); it is not in the Gaia DR3 microlensing catalogue.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

claims.text: ATLAS's 2015 images at this position are too blurred (PSF 4 px) to measure the event.
claims.author: claude-opus-5.5

hypotheses.statement: A lens magnified the star about 2.6 times around 2015 September (P 0.60, H-0009 ATLAS referee).
hypotheses.would_falsify: A repeat brightening, or a colour change.
hypotheses.author: claude-opus-5.5

notes: parallax too uncertain for an absolute magnitude (parallax_over_error <= 5)

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(271.00958351919,-18.31329775461), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(271.00958351919,-18.31329775461,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec
